page.layout: One page of text, running head at top with page number at top right; no marginal notes; catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: cognoscenda Dei uoluntate, & fidei obedientiam in eadem adprobanda, declarare, quàm iudicij acumen & ἀγχίνοιαν [?] in disceptando: & si malit Dei[?], summè sapientis & summè boni, quàm suo ipsius iudicio, stare: fitq; alijs auctor, utidem faciant.
main_text.head: VERSVS II.
main_text.p: IIII. Responsio Iehouae, de pijs & improbis, & de utrorumque sorte: cuius initium occurrit v.2.cap.2. desinit autem in fine eiusdem capitis.

p.i: Respondit autem mihi Iehouah, & dixit: Scribe uisionem, & explana in tabulis, ut percurrat qui legerit eam.

main_text.p: His uerbis attentionem & fidem flagitat Dominus, dum non audiri solum, sed etiam literis mandari uult oraculu, quod in illa uisione seruo suo aperturus erat, ut institutioni legentium seruire posset.
Solet magnitudo & acerbitas dolorum, attonitos reddere, & aciem mentium hebetare: ideo Dominus exsuscitat animum serui sui, & eum attente, quae dicerentur, expendere iubet.

page.notes: Printed page number 179 at top right. Running head is the title with chapter number, no page number. The Greek word ἀγχίνοιαν and the blotted word "Dei" are uncertain. The catchword "1.Quòd" is shown with its leading "1." as printed. The signature is "m 2".
